correctness.rationale: For g(v)=-log(1-p+p exp[-lambda(v-c)]), g is strictly increasing/concave. Jensen uniquely gives equal volume. E(n)=n g(B/n) has E''=v^2 g''(v)/n<0, log(1-exp(-E)) is strictly increasing concave, so log Youden J is strictly concave in n. Four explicit pairwise exact rational Taylor interval certificates establish 5 versus 4,6 at budget 8 and 4 versus 3,5 at budget 10; strict concavity makes each global. As B tends to infinity each finite n tends to alpha^n(1-beta^n), adjacent differences have unique sign transition, and exponential alpha^n cap bounds global tail and resolves exact limiting tie toward lower n.

value.rationale: The exact 5-to-4 reversal as total field water increases is counter to a budget-nesting heuristic in a real ecological design variable. Strict log-concavity yields a two-neighbor global optimality certificate, and the finite limiting replication formula exposes the independent-assay false-alarm penalty; neither claim requires empirical calibration and limits are explicit.
